days.title: Day 1: Shops and Products
days.description: Знакомимся с названиями магазинов и товаров

grammar.title: Shops and Products — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
📘 **Магазины и что в них продаётся**:

👟 **shoe shop** — обувной магазин (shoes)
🧥 **clothes shop** — магазин одежды (clothes)
📚 **bookshop** — книжный магазин (books)
🧸 **toy shop** — магазин игрушек (toys)
💐 **florist's** — цветочный магазин (flowers)
🍞 **baker's** — булочная (bread, cakes)
💊 **chemist's** — аптека (medicine)
📰 **newsagent's** — газетный киоск (magazines, newspapers)
📀 **music shop** — музыкальный магазин (music, instruments)
☕ **cafe** — кафе (coffee, snacks)
🍔 **fast food restaurant** — фаст-фуд (burgers, fries)

📌 **Пример**:
I want to buy a book. Let's go to the bookshop! 📚

days.title: Day 2: Articles — a/an, the, zero article
days.description: Учимся использовать артикли a/an, the и zero article

grammar.title: Articles: a/an, the, zero article
grammar.rule:
📘 **Когда использовать артикли**:

📌 **a/an** — когда мы упоминаем предмет ВПЕРВЫЕ (неопределённый):
✅ I see **a** shoe shop. (я вижу какой-то обувной магазин)
✅ She has **an** orange. (у неё есть апельсин)

📌 **the** — когда мы уже знаем, о чём идёт речь (определённый):
✅ **The** shoe shop is next to the cafe. (тот самый магазин)

📌 **zero article** — с неисчисляемыми или множественными существительными:
✅ We buy **shoes** at Benny's. (нулевой артикль)

📌 **Пример**:
Benny's is a shoe shop. The shoe shop is next to Karen's.

vocabulary.example: There are three articles in English.
First time — use a or an.
vocabulary.context_example: Первый раз — используй a или an.

days.title: Day 3: Grammar — was/were (Past Simple of 'to be')
days.description: Учим прошедшее время глагола to be

grammar.title: was/were — Past Simple of 'to be'
grammar.rule:
📘 **Прошедшее время глагола to be**:

📌 **was** — для I, he, she, it:
✅ I **was** at the mall yesterday.
✅ She **was** at the shoe shop.

📌 **were** — для you, we, they:
✅ You **were** at the cafe.
✅ They **were** at the cinema.

📌 **Отрицание**:
❌ I **wasn't** at home.
❌ They **weren't** at the park.

📌 **Вопрос**:
❓ **Were** you at the mall?
❓ **Was** she at the shop?

vocabulary.example: I was at the mall yesterday.
vocabulary.context_example: Я был в торговом центре вчера.

days.title: Day 4: Reading — Shopping Dialogue
days.description: Читаем диалог о покупках в торговом центре

grammar.title: Чтение и понимание текста
grammar.rule:
📚 **Стратегия чтения**:
1️⃣ Прочитай диалог целиком, чтобы понять общий смысл.
2️⃣ Найди, кто где был и что покупал.
3️⃣ Прочитай вопросы и найди ответы в тексте.

💡 **Совет**: Обрати внимание на артикли и was/were!

exercises.question: Where were Emma and Kelly yesterday? 🛍️
exercises.explanation: Emma says: 'I was at the mall yesterday with my mum.' 🛍️
exercises.readingText:
🛍️ SHOPPING AT THE MALL 🛍️

Emma and Kelly are at the shopping mall. Let's listen to their conversation!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

👩 EMMA: Hi, Kelly! How are you?

👩 KELLY: Hi, Emma! I'm well, thanks. What about you?

👩 EMMA: I'm well too! Do you like my new shoes? I was at the mall yesterday with my mum. We were in Benny's shoe shop because there was a sale on.

👩 KELLY: Oh! I love them! Were they expensive?

👩 EMMA: No, they weren't. They were really cheap! Only £15!

👩 KELLY: Were there any sandals in the sale?

👩 EMMA: Yes, there were lots. Do you want to go to Benny's shoe shop together this afternoon?

👩 KELLY: OK! We can have a snack at the Rainforest Cafe too.

👩 EMMA: Good idea! I love the food there.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💬 QUESTIONS ABOUT THE DIALOGUE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

grammar.title: was/were and Articles — практика
grammar.rule:
📘 **Повторение**:

📌 **was/were** (прошедшее время):
✅ I **was** at the mall.
✅ They **were** at the cinema.

📌 **Артикли**:
✅ I see **a** shoe shop.
✅ **The** shoe shop is next to the cafe.
✅ I buy **shoes** at the shop. (zero article)

📌 **Пример**:
I was at the mall yesterday. I bought shoes at Benny's. The shoes were very cheap! 🛍️

exercises.question: I ___ at the bookshop yesterday. 📚
___ you at the cinema last night? 🎬 — Yes, I was.
I see a shoe shop. — First time → a shoe shop.
exercises.explanation: Yes! First time → a shoe shop! 👟

exercises.correct: She was at the cafe yesterday.

grammar.title: Повторение: магазины, артикли, was/were
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ What is your favourite shop? (Какой твой любимый магазин?)
2️⃣ What does it sell? (Что там продают?)
3️⃣ Where is it? (Где он находится?)
4️⃣ When were you there last? (Когда ты был там в последний раз?)
5️⃣ Why do you like it? (Почему тебе нравится этот магазин?)

📌 **Пример**:
My favourite shop is Topshop. It's a clothes shop. It sells dresses, T-shirts and jeans. It's near the cafe. I was there last Friday. I bought a T-shirt. I like it because the clothes are cool! 🛍️
